location.description: The location of the Code Repository Index, for example `us-central1`.
location.rationale: Location dictates data residency and compliance. Must align with approved regional policy (e.g. AU only).

code_repository_index_id.description: Required. Id of the Code Repository Index.
code_repository_index_id.rationale: Identifier controls naming only. Security risk is minimal provided no sensitive data is embedded in the ID.

labels.description: Optional. Labels as key value pairs. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration. Please refer to the field `effective_labels` for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Labels are metadata only and do not affect access control or encryption. Should not contain secrets.

kms_key.description: Optional. Immutable. Customer-managed encryption key name, in the format `projects/*/locations/*/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/*`.
kms_key.rationale: CMKs ensure data-at-rest encryption is fully customer-controlled.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

force_destroy.description: When set to true, the Code Repository Index can be deleted even if it contains content.
force_destroy.rationale: Force deletion bypasses standard safety and retention controls
